description_en: Invoke ListAudioFiles to obtain the list of audio files under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListAudioFiles获取指定实例下的音频文件列表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-audio-files --instance-id ccc-test --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --status Completed --usage General --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAudioFiles

parameters.help_en: The paging ordinal number, ranging from 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
Converting (transforming)
Completed (transformation completed)
Failed (transformation failed)
If this parameter is not specified, resources in all statuses are queried
parameters.help_zh:
Converting（转换中）    
Completed（转换完成）    
Failed（转换失败）  
参数不传，查询所有状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: Purpose of the audio file. The default value is General (used in scenarios such as IVR). Other optional values include HoldMusic (hold music during calls)
parameters.help_zh: 音频文件用途，默认为General（用于IVR等场景）， 其他可选值为HoldMusic（通话保持等待音）
parameters.name: usage
